book.name: 1 TIMOTEO
book.title: ISBABEL CARTA NAJ SAN PABLO YATO TET NAJ TIMOTEO

content: Cuybanile yin̈ tzet wal isbeybaln̈en ebnaj chioc ijbalomal
Yin̈ caw yeli, ta ay hunu mac chioc ijbalomal xol yuninal Comam Dios, huneꞌ munil tuꞌ caw sakꞌalcanoj.

Yajaꞌ haꞌ mac chioc ijbalomal tuꞌ, machojab nino istxꞌojal sata anma, machojab chissay hunuxa ix. Toholojab chiyute isnabal yeb isbeybal, yilal yakꞌni ebnaj bay chiway anma chiecꞌ iscꞌatan̈. Helanojab ebnaj iscuywahi, yeb xin ayojab yelapno yul sat anma.
Machojab ucꞌum teꞌoj, machojab akꞌom howal, yeb machojab ayco yanma yin̈ chꞌen melyu. Wal xin cꞌulchꞌanojab iscꞌul yeb xin chewla winaj chute isba.
Yohtajojab yakꞌni cuybanile yul yatut haxinwal yijem chielico yuninal, yeb xin chixiw yuninal tet.
Yajaꞌ ta mach chu iscuyni naj yuninal yul yatut, maẍticꞌam chu yocpaxo naj ilwal yin̈ mac ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam.

Huneꞌ naj chꞌoc ijbalomal xol yuninal Comam Dios tuꞌ, machojabtaj hunu naj tolto chahn̈e Comam Jesucristo yul yanma, yuto ta hac tuꞌ subuta isloloꞌn̈en isba naj, cat yaycꞌay naj yin̈ isyaꞌtajil hacaꞌ yu yaycꞌay naj matzwalil.
Wal xin, cꞌulojab isbeybal naj ijbalom tuꞌ sata anma maẍto chaco isba yul iskꞌab Comam, haxinwal machi mac chiꞌinilo ispixan naj, yeb mach chiaycꞌay naj yul iskꞌab naj matzwalil.
Cuybanile yin̈ tzet chu ismunla ebnaj diácono
Hacpax tuꞌ ebnaj chioc diáconohal, ayojab yelapno ebnaj yul sat anma. Machojab nananta tzet chi-la-yala, machojab chiuqꞌui ebnaj. Machojab ayoco yanma yin̈ yikꞌni ismelyu yu lekꞌtiꞌal.
Yilal yanico yanma ebnaj yin̈ cuybanile akꞌbilcano jet yu Comam Dios, huneꞌ cuybanile chabilxayto yul janma, yeb xin sajojabn̈eticꞌa isnabal ebnaj.
Babel yilal yillaxi ta mach ismul ebnaj, lahwi tuꞌ xin cat yakꞌlax ismunil ebnaj yin̈ diáconohal.

Hac pax tuꞌ xin ebix janab chioc yin̈ huneꞌ munil tiꞌ, cꞌulojab isbeybal ebix yul sat anma. Machojab hobom tzotiꞌ ebix. Nanojabn̈eticꞌa yu ebix yin̈ tzet chiswatxꞌe. Yijemojab chiyute isba ebix yin̈ sunil.
Ebnaj juẍta chioc diáconohal, machojab hunoxa ix chissay ebnaj, yohtajojab ebnaj iscuywa yul yatut yeb yin̈ sunil yuninal.
Yin̈ caw yeli ebnaj diácono cꞌul chiyute isba yin̈ ismunil, chioccano iswinajil ebnaj cat yoc yip yanma ebnaj istzotel yin̈ cuybanile yin̈ Comam Jesucristo, huneꞌ xaheyayto yul heyanma.
Ayco yin̈ incꞌulan intohan cachwilnojan yin̈ lembil, yajaꞌ xin chintzꞌibn̈etojan huneꞌ hum tiꞌ tawet,

yun̈e ta chiecꞌ tiempo wapnihan, hawohtaxa tzet chawatxꞌe xol yuninal Comam Dios. Han̈on̈ tiꞌ yatut Comam Dios itzitz jehi, yuto han̈on̈ caw chijalicꞌo huneꞌ cuybanile yet isyelal tiꞌ, yeb xin han̈on̈ chijaco yip huneꞌ cuybanile tiꞌ yin̈ sat anma.
Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalcanojan, caw aycano yelapno ye huneꞌ cocuybanil chiꞌakꞌlax tiꞌ, yuxin chiyal hacaꞌ tiꞌ:

content.text: Yaco isba Comam anmahil, yet yulicꞌo coxol. Haxa Comam Espíritu Santo yeniloj tato tohol isnabal. Ilbil Comam yu ebnaj ángel. Hallaxicꞌo Istzotiꞌ Comam xol anma nan con̈obal. Ay anma yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ caw yaco yanma yin̈ Comam. Chahlax Comam yin̈ iscꞌulchꞌanil yul satcan̈, ẍi.
